propositions: Priority mapping is made config-driven via per-project priority_map axis in MappingLayer, keyed by string priority values, with a built-in str-keyed baseline dict matching int-keyed value_maps.LOCAL_PRIORITY_TO_JIRA.
Unmapped priority values drift (field omitted from payload, warning recorded) rather than failing sync, as priority is a soft field with no vocabulary validation.

Two new resolver functions _effective_priority_map_for and _effective_create_defaults_for are added to outbound_differ.py to resolve effective maps per project, symmetric with existing _effective_status_map_for.

CREATE operations gain optional priority_map and create_defaults kwargs threaded through OutboundMapper Protocol and leaf bodies (Cloud and DC), with create_defaults merging into required-beyond-baseline fields before baseline computed fields.
UPDATE operations gain optional priority_map kwarg threaded to map_fields_to_remote and compute_update_fields, while create_defaults is create-only and not threaded to updates.
Test doubles explicitly add priority_map=None and create_defaults=None to Protocol signatures on threading paths, while **kwargs doubles absorb new kwargs unchanged.
